name: MD Jariful Rahman
headline: Backend-focused Software Developer with full-stack capabilities. I build clean, reliable APIs and resilient background workflows—emphasizing disciplined architecture and pragmatic, end-to-end delivery.
summary: Software engineer graduating from University of Dhaka (IIT) with hands-on industry experience at Tekarsh Bangladesh Ltd. I specialize in building type-safe APIs, PostgreSQL data layers, and asynchronous worker systems, pairing disciplined engineering with end-to-end delivery.

about.sectionDescription: My journey, engineering principles, practical craft, and future technical trajectory.

steps.label: Foundations & Experience
steps.title: Software Engineering at DU (IIT) & Industry Track Record
steps.description: Completed BSSE coursework at the University of Dhaka (IIT), focusing on systems from first principles and end-to-end delivery. During my 6-month software engineering tenure at Tekarsh Bangladesh Ltd, I engineered automated test suites (Appium, WebdriverIO), executed API performance load testing, and shipped production features across web applications.

steps.label: Engineering Mindset
steps.title: Extensible Architecture, Intentional Data Modeling & Resilience
steps.description: I approach backend development as an interconnected engineering system rather than isolated tasks. I prioritize architecting clean, extensible modular boundaries, crafting thoughtful data models from schema design to optimization, and baking in proactive failure recovery and scalability from day one—ensuring end-to-end reliability as systems evolve.

steps.label: Core Craft
steps.title: Type-Safe API Design, Relational Data & Async Execution
steps.description: My core sweet spot is building type-safe, RESTful APIs with Python (FastAPI) and Node.js (Express) backed by structured PostgreSQL databases. I focus on clean request validation, efficient database queries, and offloading heavy tasks to asynchronous background workers to keep endpoints fast and responsive—packaged reliably with Docker.

steps.label: Future Trajectory
steps.title: Distributed Architectures, Message Queues & Cloud DevOps
steps.description: Looking ahead, I am actively expanding into distributed system architectures, event-driven message queues, and decoupled worker daemons to handle asynchronous workflows at scale. Alongside this, I am deepening my DevOps practices—advancing automated CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and resilient cloud deployments.
